description: Wire four newly-built enrichment modules into signal_analyser_v2 to improve weak-signal discrimination. Modules to integrate: community_signal_enrichment.py (compute_score returns sigmoid-weighted community score), tool_description_safety_enrichment.py (compute_score returns safety assessment), permission_scope_enrichment.py (compute_score returns permission scope score), temporal_stability_enrichment.py (compute_score returns age-based stability score). Each signal currently shows only 4 distinct values; enrichment must use MULTIPLE metadata fields per the enrichment contract. Reference spec section 3 (Signal Invariant) and section 4 (Freshness SLAs). The signal_bridge.py already exists at 2026-05-17; this wiring ensures enrichments feed through to mcp_signal_enrichments table.
